g.aria-label: Bench check on a Raspberry Pi 5, before power
housings on their headers, plugs free, card out of its slot
If the Raspberry Pi 5 is on, power off the Raspberry Pi 5: unplug its power, and its network
cable if it is powered over PoE.
Touch the metal shell of a USB socket on the Raspberry Pi 5.
The USB socket is not in this photograph: it is on the Pi itself, under the HAT.
one probe on contact 1 (GND) of a plug
Contact 1 of each plug to the shell: the meter must beep.
Contact 6 of each plug (VCC, cut back): silent to the shell and to every other contact.
The plug and the meter are sketched.
